name: 冰爽水感轻薄防晒喷雾款

category.leaf: 清爽水感全身防晒喷雾

description: 清爽水感防晒喷雾，轻薄不油腻，全身可用随时补喷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: ice blue #BFE0F0 and violet-periwinkle gradient #99A5DE for hero and scene shots, clean white #FFFFFF and pale ice blue #EEF2FA for infographic shots, periwinkle blue #8FB4D9 with blush pink #F2AFC4 color-block for packaging and closing shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool bright studio lighting, soft directional keys with soft contact shadows, dew-fresh highlights, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy ice-blue surface #BFE0F0 and matte pale panels #EEF2FA
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-navy #3A3F5C or white #FFFFFF, all copy wrapped in 「」; periwinkle accent #6B7FD7 reserved for thin-line icons and small badges; blush pink #F2AFC4 kept as a color-block surface only, never as a text color
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright can silhouette and scale across the set, hero can shown full and uncut, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh cool sun-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of ice blue #BFE0F0, violet-periwinkle gradient base #99A5DE, charcoal-navy text #3A3F5C and one periwinkle accent #6B7FD7, with blush pink #F2AFC4 reserved as a color-block surface for packaging and closing shots; cool bright studio lighting with soft directional keys and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal-navy or white; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的正面全貌
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, can standing upright, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The can standing upright, straight-on eye-level view, full product visible, filling 60-70% of the frame and composed as one clean finished shot with even margins all around. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no SPF or PA numbers, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大暴晒闷热、黏腻油腻的痛点，引出喷雾的清凉解法

shots.lighting: left panel harsh warm midday light, right panel cool soft light
shots.background: warm sandy beige #E8D9C4 on the left panel, cool ice blue #BFE0F0 on the right panel
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3A3F5C
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical eye-level framing. Left panel: a bare arm under harsh midday sunlight on a hot street, skin looking sticky and uncomfortable, warm harsh light on a warm sandy beige background #E8D9C4. Right panel: {product} releasing a fine cooling mist over the same arm, cool soft light on a cool ice blue background #BFE0F0. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. shots.intent: 用雾化瞬间的细腻水雾证明喷雾细、覆盖匀

shots.lighting: soft cool rim light from the right backlighting the mist particles
shots.background: soft violet-to-periwinkle gradient #99A5DE with one large soft circle in #6B7FD7 behind the can
shots.whitespace: minimal, the mist moment is the whole point

Photographed from a low side angle at nozzle level, shallow depth of field with the nozzle sharp and the mist soft. Soft cool rim light from the right backlighting the mist particles. The mist and nozzle fill 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the mist moment is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no heavy water droplets, no hands, no fingers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 从 12 张防晒喷雾爆款详情长图切片提炼。panel-10 为近似重复的白底特写，并入 shot-01 弃用；panel-02 模特面部、panel-11 源品牌故事（品牌名与门店信息）及 panel-12 店铺页脚/二维码全部剥离，仅保留版式角色重写为通用信任与收口镜头；SPF/PA、容量、功效与资质一律未写实，相关文案以 {selling_point}/{callout} 槽位交由使用方填写，信任镜改以喷头工艺细节呈现。
